Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller is responsible for keeping the address mapping from EffectiveAddr to the device physical base address unchanged once this function is invoked. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping changes after this function is called. If address translation is not used, use Config->BaseAddress for this parameters, passing the physical address instead.

briefdescription.para: Adds a command to the software list of commands.

detaileddescription.para: Prepares the four Command Words and one Parameter Word from the Command structure passed by the user application, then adds them to a list of commands maintained in software. Both CMDRAM and PARAMRAM are divided into two regions, one for reads and one for writes. Each region can hold 256 commands, with each entry containing four Command RAM words and one Parameter RAM word.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the Axi TrafGen instance to be worked on.
Pointer to Command structure.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if reached max number of command entries.
